name: Bounding Box Overlay Host Validation Exerciser
description: Task-local exerciser for native red-box overlay buttons on an exact Cubism host: registers two SDK buttons, verifies both are visibly installed, clicks both through real Robot gestures, and verifies both disappear after their registrations close.

permissions.reason: Registers and closes two task-local bounding-box overlay buttons and records real click evidence on the exact host.
Reads the public Turboism runtime/selection snapshot for diagnostic-only selection-state telemetry on the exact host; never mutates selection or model.
